punctured_face_rule.search: Test unordered pairs of allowed_row_fields. A candidate is valid only if each field has exactly 9 source-native values, the Cartesian product has 81 addresses, the 80 rows occupy 80 distinct address pairs, and exactly one address is empty.

ten_octet_rule.search: Test each single allowed_row_field as a grouping key. A candidate is valid only if it produces exactly 10 groups of exactly 8 rows. No compound key is accepted for ten-octet PASS because arbitrary field products can overfit 80 rows.

pairing_symmetry_metrics.randomization_control: Shuffle descriptor bundles across fixed row ids and fixed conjugate links; recompute pair_field_consistency.
